style: dark fantasy 1987 Mac/Amiga adventure game pixel art, limited 16-color palette, heavy blacks, painterly Shadowgate style

scenes.description: interior of a stone chapel at dawn, tall arched stained-glass window depicting a saint lancing a red dragon, white stone altar with a silver longsword resting on it, oak door bound in iron to the right, lectern with open tome to the left, single candle flame, dust motes in slanted golden light

medieval castle courtyard at bruised purple-orange dusk, stone well with mossy roof and a black crow perched, old woman stablehand beside a saddled horse, posted parchment proclamation with red wax seal, raised iron portcullis revealing a road west, crescent moon

blasted ashen forest under blood-orange sky, stark black skeletal trees, forking dirt path with northern branch climbing to a smoking distant mountain peak, southern branch descending to a hollow with warm orange firelight, wounded ranger in dark cloak slumped against a tree stump bleeding, a black raven on a low branch

shadowy forest hollow inside cavern walls, sorceress in violet robe with golden eyes seated by a cold white flame that gives no smoke, flat offering stone bearing a dark chalice of wine, a single red dragon scale glowing like ember, and a small black scrying mirror

vast dragon's cavern lair lit by molten red heat-glow, enormous red dragon coiled on a hoard of gold coins with a pale crescent scar on its brow, eyes open and gentle, six royal crossbowmen in tabards aiming bolts from the shadows on the left, a robed chancellor watching from a high stone ledge on the upper right, paladin silhouette in foreground with raised sword

tragic dark ending scene, slain grey-bearded man with crescent scar lying peacefully on a pile of gold coins where a dragon once lay, paladin standing over him with bloody sword lowered, multiple crossbow bolts flying toward the paladin from off-screen, near-black palette with deep blood reds

triumphant dawn ending scene, paladin standing with raised silver sword beside a vast protective red dragon wing, a clawed dragon hand resting gently on the paladin's shoulder, golden sunrise breaking over distant mountains, slain robed chancellor in background with scattered crossbow bolts

items.description: ornate silver longsword called Dawnbreaker, gold pommel embossed with a sigil of a coiled dragon cradling a sun, leather-wrapped grip, item icon on transparent background
folded aged parchment letter sealed with a red wax seal bearing a knight's crest, item icon on transparent background
gold signet ring with red enamel face engraved with the letter V, faintly crusted with dried blood, item icon on transparent background
single large dragon scale the color of banked embers, deep red with glowing orange center, item icon on transparent background
